title: Start right, control the retainer, prove your value
course_title: Advanced Client Management: Keeping and Growing High-Value Clients

say: Start right, control the retainer, and prove your value.
This is the video for module two of Advanced Client Management.
The first month of a new account sets habits that last for years. If the client learns that you answer WhatsApp at 11pm, they will expect it.

say: Onboarding is the planned start of a client relationship, so that expectations are written down and agreed before real deadlines begin.

say: In this module you build an onboarding kit, learn to control a retainer, and run a quarterly review that shows the client what they get for their money.

say: First, hold a kickoff meeting within three working days of signing. Cover the client's goals, the agreed scope in plain words, who is involved, how you will communicate, what you need from them and by when, and the first delivery date.
Send written notes the same day.

panel.heading: Three tools for a clean start

cards.d: Within three working days of signing. Goals, scope, people, communication, client inputs, first delivery.
One page: channels, response times, update days, approvals and escalation.
Who is Responsible, Accountable, Consulted and Informed. Exactly one Accountable per task.

say: Second, a communication charter. For example: replies within 4 working hours, Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm, and the client approves work within 2 working days. It protects your evenings, and the client knows when to expect answers.

say: Third, a RACI chart. For each task, it names who does the work, who owns the final decision, who gives input first, and who is told after.
In Ada's hospital account, the medical director, not the agency, signs off any post with health information.

say: A word on safety. Never ask for a client's personal passwords.

panel.heading: Access the safe way
left: Use client data for other work
right: Get your own login or partner access

say: Ask to be added with your own login, so access can be removed when the work ends. Keep client data private and use it only for the agreed work. In Nigeria, the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 sets rules for handling personal data.

say: A retainer is a fixed monthly fee for agreed ongoing work. Its quiet danger is scope creep, where small extra requests pile up until you do far more work for the same fee.
Halima's agency has a school retainer for 30 hours a month.
The fee is 450,000 naira. Divide it by 30 hours, and her effective hourly rate is 15,000 naira.
On day 15, her log shows 21 hours used. At that pace she will reach 42 hours, which is 12 hours over, or 180,000 naira of unpaid work.
The log shows 9 of those hours went on a landing page that was never in the scope.
New deliverables, extra revision rounds and rush work are change requests. First, log the request.
Then estimate it. Halima estimates 10 hours, which is 150,000 naira at her retainer rate.
Offer choices: approve it as extra work, swap it for 10 hours of planned work, or schedule it for next month.
The client chooses, and you record the choice in writing. Track hours every Friday, and when 75% of hours are used, tell the client and agree priorities.

panel.heading: Handle a change request
panel.rule: Never a flat no, never a silent yes.

say: Every three months, hold a quarterly business review with your contact and the sponsor. Report against the goals agreed at kickoff, using the client's own data.
Ada's bakery client set a goal of 600 online orders. They got 690, which is 115% of target.
Then share what worked and what did not. Ada added an honest note: some orders would have come anyway from loyal customers.
Give their priorities as much time as your results. Ask what has changed in their business.
Close by agreeing two or three goals for next quarter, with owners and the next review date.
Never inflate results. One inflated claim can undo a year of trust.

To remember. Write expectations down in the first month. Know your effective rate. Treat extra work as a change request with clear options. And in every quarterly review, report honestly against the goals you agreed.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Agree charter and RACI before deadlines start
Effective rate is fee divided by hours
Answer extra requests with options in writing
Report results honestly against agreed goals
